web_ui.title: VC screening report
web_ui.description: Review company scores, method coverage, supporting evidence, and diligence gaps from a completed run.

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording only; domain work and approvals keep their existing controls.

starter_questions: Can I start with the synthetic startup packets?
How should I organize documents for my own companies?
Which claim or scoring assumption needs more diligence?

setup_guide.introduction: Try the fictional startup packets to see how a screening report handles claims and missing evidence. For a real review, choose a folder of authorized company documents.

sample.title: Synthetic startup screening
sample.description: Screen the bundled fictional startup packets using the usual workflow.
sample.expected_output: Company reports with dated sources, the seven screening methods and open diligence questions.

real.introduction: Choose your startup-document folder. A subfolder per company makes the packets easier to identify.

fields.label: Document folder
fields.description: Local folder monitored for startup documents; first-level folders are treated as companies.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Local folder where per-company reports and the company index should be written.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll compare company claims across the screening methods so you can see where the evidence agrees or leaves a gap.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the screening report, choose a company, and check the sources behind one diligence question.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open the output folder, choose a company report, and check the dated sources behind one open question.
